correction.same: Clock in and clock out are the same

finding.ARBZG_3_OVER_8: Worked more than 8 hours ({{minutes}}). Allowed if the average over six calendar months or 24 weeks stays at 8 hours per workday.
finding.ARBZG_3_OVER_10: Worked more than 10 hours ({{minutes}}). The maximum working time is exceeded.
finding.ARBZG_4_BREAK_SHORT: Break too short: {{requiredMinutes}} required, {{actualMinutes}} taken. Only breaks of 15 minutes or more count.
finding.ARBZG_4_CONTINUOUS_6H: Worked {{continuousMinutes}} in a row. More than 6 hours without a break is not allowed.
finding.ARBZG_5_REST_UNDER_11H: Rest period since the last shift only {{restMinutes}}. 11 hours are required.
finding.ARBZG_9_SUNDAY: Work on a Sunday. Only allowed under the exceptions in § 10 ArbZG.
finding.ARBZG_9_HOLIDAY: Work on a public holiday. Only allowed under the exceptions in § 10 ArbZG.
